title: Edmonton Explorer | Hop On Hop Off Trolley Tour
includes: Hop On or Off as many times as you like
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Edmonton Explorer provides the premier vintage trolley sightseeing experience in Alberta. Join a hop-on, hop-off tour on our 1920s-inspired Molly Trolley’s to connect our many curated stops. With 24-hour and 72-hour tickets, you can pick where you jump on and off to discover all of Edmonton’s best attractions, enjoying a seamless, story-driven journey.
As the official ride of the Discover Edmonton Pass, we make it easy to connect West Edmonton Mall, downtown, and the River Valley into a seamless, stress-free adventure—whether you're here for a quick day trip or a full long weekend - you'll be able to get everywhere you want to go easily!
September and October we run Route 3: The Shoulder Season single-loop. Running until Thanksgiving weekend.
